interface.defaultPrompt: Choose one bundled writing skill for the target text and task. Honor an explicit skill name; otherwise use yomiyasu for existing Japanese prose, natural-japanese for new Japanese documents or diagnosis, and humanizer for non-Japanese prose. Do not automatically chain skills.
